name: Rahul Chanda Photography
description: Commercial and product photographer in Dehradun, India. Product, food & beverage, footwear, fashion, and brand campaign photography shot and retouched in-house, on-location across Uttarakhand and pan-India.
summary: Rahul Chanda is a commercial photographer in Dehradun, Uttarakhand (India) serving brands, e-commerce sellers, restaurants and agencies with studio-grade product, food & beverage, footwear, fashion and campaign photography plus in-house retouching. Founded 2019. 120+ brands served.

services.name: Product Photography
services.description: E-commerce packshots, Amazon/Flipkart/Shopify-ready product imagery, cosmetics, watches, jewelry, D2C brands.

services.name: Food & Beverage Photography
services.description: Restaurant, cafe, cloud kitchen, menu and delivery-app (Swiggy/Zomato) photography, beverage splash and food styling.

services.name: Footwear Photography
services.description: Shoe and sneaker e-commerce angle sequences, footwear catalog photography, leather-goods detail macros, marketplace-ready white-background packshots.

services.name: Fashion Photography
services.description: On-model lookbooks, editorial campaigns, apparel e-commerce imagery, model coordination and creative direction.

services.name: Commercial Campaign Photography
services.description: Brand campaigns, advertising photography, billboards, digital ads, brand launches.
